name: schedule-extractor
description: Extract plant legends and material schedules from a construction/landscape PDF into an Excel workbook (one sheet per detected schedule).
when_to_use: Use when the user attaches a construction, landscape, or site PDF and asks to pull plant legends, material schedules, planting tables, or similar tabular schedules out of it into a spreadsheet. Do NOT use for free-text questions or for PDFs with no schedule/legend tables.

input_file.description: Handle of the attached PDF to process, e.g. "file_1". Must be one of the file handles listed in the conversation.

ignore_first_column.description: Drop the first table column (often a column of plant symbols/codes rather than data). Set false to keep it.

skip_pages.description: Zero-based page indices to skip (e.g. cover sheets). Empty means scan every page.

output: An .xlsx workbook with one sheet per detected schedule (named "Page N, Schedule M"), plus a short text summary of how many schedules were found.
